THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER Accused No.1 in Crime No.96/2024 registered by Ramanagara Women Police Station, Ramanagara District for the offences punishable under Sections 376 of IPC, Sections 4 & 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Sections 9 & 11 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage (Karnataka Amendment) Act, 2016 is before this Court seeking regular bail.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel appearing for respondent No.1.
3. Respondent No.2 who is served in the matter has remained unrepresented before this Court.
4. FIR in Crime No.96/2024 was registered by Ramanagara Women Police Station, Ramanagara District against the petitioner herein initially for the offence punishable under Section 9 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage (Karnataka Amendment) Act, 2016, on the basis NC:
2025:KHC:15438 of first information dated 29.07.2024 received from CDPO, Ramanagara.

sentences.text:
During the course of investigation, he was arrested on 04.01.2025.
9.
The victim girl, aged about 17 years 4 months who said to have studied upto I PUC has given her statement under Section 183 of BNS, 2023 before the jurisdictional Magistrate on 20.08.2024.
In the said statement she has stated that the petitioner is her maternal aunt's son and they were in love with each other.
After her parents came to know about the same, she was abused and assaulted in her house and she learnt that her marriage will be performed with some other boy.
Therefore, on 31.03.2024 she had left her house and had gone to Maddur and married the petitioner in a temple at NC: 2025:KHC:15438 Maddur.
Thereafter, she had informed about her marriage to her parents.
10. The victim girl has not made any allegation in her statement against the petitioner about he committing any sexual assault on her.
The petitioner, who has no other criminal antecedents is in custody from 04.01.2025.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.

11. Accordingly, the following:
ORDER
The Criminal Petition is allowed.
